text: At dawn Gus went up with his lantern. Behind the lamp run three cables.
Two were whole, and wet with sea-mist. The third was cut clean through. And it was dry.
Dry means cut from inside, after the mist. And whoever did it left in a hurry.
The window was open. The stairs were… painted. Dunn had painted them that very morning.
Yellow paint. On the stairs, going down. Across the grass. Toward a door in the rock that Gus had never seen.
